text:
reena: Heads-up — I ran into a user ticket where the /v1/generate API docs show mixed shapes. OpenAPI example uses `input: \"text\"` while the JS SDK and curl snippets show `messages: [...]`. Caused confusion for people migrating to chat models. Can we standardize?

sam: Yep, this is expected drift. Server accepts both for now but new chat-first models want `messages`. Docs should: 1) Prefer chat-style `messages` in the examples, 2) keep a short legacy example for `input`, and 3) include a tiny migration snippet.

kai: I can take this. Will update the API reference OpenAPI examples, the inline JS SDK snippet, and the curl/python examples so they all match. Plan: show a recommended chat example, then a one-liner migration mapping. Example I'll add:
```js
// recommended
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Summarize this' }] })

// legacy -> migrate
// { input: 'Summarize this' } -> { messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Summarize this' }] }
```
I'll also update examples/* and add a small test to the snippet-runner. PR incoming.

reena: Add a heading "Migration from input -> messages" in the API reference and cross-link the migration guide. Also please update the OpenAPI example block so the auto-generated SDK snippets remain consistent.

kai: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4378 3
docs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR #4378 705 preview: https://deploy-preview-4378--docs.redwood.ai/api-reference/generate

maria: Linter caught another issue: response schema documents `choices` as an object. Live responses are arrays. We should change the schema to `choices: [ { index: number, text?: string, delta?: string } ]` and include two response samples: non-streaming (choices[].text) and streaming (choices[].delta fragments). Suggested non-stream sample:
```json
{ "id": "gen-01", "choices": [ { "index": 0, "text": "Hello!" } ] }
```
And a short streaming explanation showing incremental `delta` pieces.

sam: Good catch. Also add a note that legacy clients might see `text` populated on final chunk while streaming uses `delta`. We should surface both shapes in examples.

kai: I'll update the OpenAPI response examples and the example runner tests to assert `choices` is an array. Will push an extra commit to the PR for that.

reena: After merge, I'll add a tiny blurb to the release notes and the migration guide. Thanks for handling quickly. :thumbsup:
